name: Particles-TS-TW
title: Particles
description: A full-bleed WebGL starfield of small glowing dots that drift, slowly rotate in depth and sway under the pointer. It gives a dark page depth without images or video.
use: You want a quiet moving backdrop behind dark hero copy without images or video.
avoid: The loop renders every frame on the GPU, so it drains battery and struggles on low-end devices.
a11y: The WebGL loop ignores reduced-motion settings and the canvas carries no text or labels. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black rectangular stage scattered with tiny glowing dots in white, pale lilac and cyan. Most are pinpricks, a few burn larger, and the density is uneven, thicker toward the left and centre.
behaves: The dots drift and rotate slowly in depth, each wobbling on its own path, so the field never settles. Moving the pointer nudges the whole cloud away from the cursor.
customise: Particle count, colours, spread, size, speed and camera distance are props; hover response can be toggled. There is no markup to edit.
weight: heavy: A WebGL point cloud redrawn on every animation frame.
demo: Full-bleed black panel with a 320-particle field in white, lilac and cyan.
polishWhy: Even, believable drift and clean dots; the field is sparse and the look is a familiar one.
